claims.claim: BaseExportProcessor.validatePrerequisites throws 'Model Check Failed: Missing required models [TransHisPgModel]. Available models: [...]' when getRequiredModelName() returns 'TransHisPgModel' and mainProcess.models['TransHisPgModel'] is undefined.

In start.ts, initService loops over DB_LIST and catches connection errors per alias without rethrowing for non-default databases, so when 'trans-his-pg' fails to connect, connections['trans-his-pg'] is omitted while MainProcess initializes the other 15 databases including CentralReconModel.

svc-env.ts includes RECONCILE_MARIADB_HOST..POOLSIZE in REQUIRED_KEYS but omits TRANS_HIS_PG_HOST..POOLSIZE, so missing TRANS_HIS_PG_* variables in Vault or env are not caught by VaultSecurity.checkMissingEnvVariable().
